statements.impact_statement: Codex reviewed Trivy 0.76.1 at e713f67f7d54decdcd9b3132c9751833dcced698 on 2026-10-28. Code Polishy enables version, anonymous OCI database download through go-containerregistry/net/http, and offline archive scans. Inputs cannot configure SPIFFE/xDS credentials or Sigstore OIDC; image-configuration JWT analysis uses a separate JWK implementation. No enabled input reaches go-jose RSA private-key validation. Reassess by 2026-11-13 UTC and whenever the image, execution contract, inputs or advisory changes.

Codex inspected both pinned Linux amd64 and arm64 executables on 2026-11-08. Validated Go runtime function-name tables, including inlined functions, contain html.init and charset routines but none of the affected HTML Parse entry points or parser methods. The vulnerable text-node coalescing code is absent from both binaries. The x/net v0.60.0 module remains present. Exact platform and executable digests, positive controls and reproducible inspection are recorded in the immutable evidence. Reassess by 2026-11-13 UTC and whenever the image, build settings, execution contract or advisory changes.

evidence: Scanner execution-path and binary evidence: https://github.com/riteofstring/code-polishy/blob/5aef31a07f0904c7fd1c05cf6e9f0573d371501f/docs/design/trivy-scanner-assessments.md . Both assessments bind this exact image and code-polishy-trivy/v1.
